command: npm audit --json, repository root, locked dependencies
method: Every disposition below was re-measured for this workspace. FRONT-04's classification was not carried forward, because the FRONT-04 correction was explicit that a developer's own non-blocking judgement may not be inherited.
Dependency paths traced with `npm ls <package>` rather than assumed.
Client-bundle reachability tested by scanning every emitted file under frontend/representative-workspace/.next/static for the package name after a production build.
Fix availability and semver impact read from npm audit's own fixAvailable field.

hardening_verified_this_round.reason: This workspace ships no images, so the framework's image-optimisation endpoint is pure attack surface on an origin that renders confidential case material, and it is the one path by which sharp's inherited libvips advisories become reachable at runtime.
